product.description: Monoprice™Monoprice Dual USB-C Card Reader with SD & microSD Support, Up to 312 MB/sThe Monoprice Dual USB-C Card Reader lets you read and write to SD and microSD cards simultaneously via a single USB-C connection. Designed for USB-C laptops, tablets, and phones, it supports UHS II media with transfer speeds up to 312 MB/s, making it suitable for business workflows, education environments, and everyday file access without technical setup. Read Two Cards at Once from One USB-C PortYou can access files from an SD card and a microSD card simultaneously without swapping adapters or reconnecting cables. The reader includes dedicated SD and microSD slots and supports concurrent operation over a single USB-C host connection. High Speed Transfers for Large FilesLarge documents, photos, and videos are copied faster, reducing wait time during backups or file sharing. The reader supports UHS-II media with data transfer speeds up to 312 MB/s, as specified by the Secure Digital UHS-II standard. Actual speed depends on the card and host device. Broad Media CompatibilityYou can use older cards as well as newer high capacity media without changing readers. Supported standards include SD, SDHC, SDXC, UHS I, UHS II, Secure Digital v1.0 through v5.0, DDR200 mode, and MultiMediaCard (MMC) formats with capacities up to 2 TB. USB-C for Modern Laptops and TabletsOne connector works across newer business and education devices without legacy USB adapters. The reader uses a USB Type-C male connector with a USB 3.0 interface, while remaining backward-compatible with USB 2.0 hosts. No Drivers or External Power RequiredUsers can start transferring files immediately without IT setup or software installs. The reader is USB bus powered and supports plug and play operation on compatible operating systems. Package Contents• 1x Monoprice Dual USB-C Card Reader• 1x User Manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
